description: Use this when the user asks for a sound effect, click, notification, jingle, audio, music, song or soundtrack, or mentions Moose Tracker: returns usage notes. No arguments gives a short index (workflow, limits, formats, next steps); topic opens one section: syntax, limits, styles, recipes, presets, mtl, instrument, effects, modulation, drums, loops, formats, sfx, examples, errors, genres, generators, samples, search, not_supported, workflow, volume, mix, sounds, character, photos; q searches presets and the sample library; with topic="syntax", q opens one syntax section (q="arp") or a field. Song text up to 1024 KB; one audio file holds about 5 min as WAV, longer as Ogg or Opus (exact seconds per format in the index). Tool list 1.7.2. Schema 0479948e.

category.description: topic=samples: only this category (drums, keys, pads, ...)
